description: Search everything GolfCore holds for more than 30,000 golf courses in more than 180 countries and territories. Ask by course name ('Pebble Beach'), by its name in local script ('宮崎カントリークラブ'), by architect ('Donald Ross'), by slug ('pebble-beach'), by place, passing just the place name ('St Andrews', 'Monterey'), or about GolfCore itself ('what does a caddie master use GolfCore for'). A course comes back with its address, town, region, country, coordinates, timezone, phone and website, its archit

coverage.description: Optional. Only courses GolfCore has this for: 'contours' lidar green contour maps, 'traced' a traced course map, 'scorecard' a hole-by-hole card, 'rated' USGA course and slope ratings.

near.description: Optional. A point to search around, such as the person's location or their hotel. Courses come back nearest first, each with its distance in miles.

query.description: What you are looking for, in plain English. May be empty when near is given; with near, it filters courses by name or town.

radius_miles.description: Optional, with near. How far to look, in miles. Default 25, maximum 250.

scope.description: Optional. Narrow the search to these scopes: 'slug' treats the query as a GolfCore course slug and returns that exact course, 'courses' matches courses by name and town, 'scorecards' attaches each course's per-hole card and tee ratings to it, 'city', 'region' and 'country' return pages that count and list every course in a place, 'product' returns GolfCore's own pages. Omit to search all of them. Combine freely, e.g. ["slug","scorecards"] for one exact card, or ["city","courses"]. Leave 'scorecards' out when you only need to know which courses exist; the cards are large.

name: golfcore__search
